newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Simon DeBartolo started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Simon DeBartolo started.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Bill Acheson started Simon DeBartolo Group Inc with an outperform rating and set a 12-month price target for the stock of $30.

-- Acheson said he expects the company, a product of the merger of two Real Estate Investment Trusts (REIT) this summer, to earn $2.31 per share in funds from operations in calendar 1996 $2.57 in calendar 1997.

-- "The main good things here are you have two good organizations that are very complementary," Acheson said. He described Simon as more entrepreneurial and DeBartolo as a "good redeveloper" that had suffered from a lack of capital in recent years.

-- "The new Simon DeBartolo has excellent access to capital at lower costs," the analyst said, noting that the merged company's cost of capital had dropped to nine percent from 10.6 percent previously.
-- Simon DeBartolo had gained 1/8 to 27-3/8 in early trading Wednesday.
